title: The Only Checklist You Need for Bathroom Cleaning
description: Follow this ultimate bathroom deep cleaning checklist to sanitize every surface and learn when to book professional home cleaning.
content:
A spotless bathroom is essential to a healthy home cleaning routine. Bathrooms accumulate humidity, soap scum, bacteria, mold, and hard water stains faster than any other space in your home. Without proper deep cleaning, these issues can affect hygiene, indoor air quality, and even surface longevity.

To help you stay organized and efficient, here is a complete bathroom deep cleaning checklist that covers every surface, fixture, and hidden corner. Follow it step by step for a sparkling, sanitized finish.

Bathroom Deep Cleaning Checklist

  • Gather all supplies: multipurpose cleaner, disinfectant, glass cleaner, microfiber cloths, scrub brush, grout brush, mop, bucket, and a pumice stone for stubborn mineral deposits

  • Wear protective rubber gloves before handling cleaning agents

  • Remove all toiletries, towels, bath mats, and personal care items from surfaces

  • Dust light fixtures, ceiling corners, and exhaust vents before applying any liquids

  • Spray tiles and grout with a solution of equal parts distilled white vinegar and warm water

  • Allow the solution to sit for 5 minutes to break down soap scum and grime

  • Scrub grout lines thoroughly to remove discoloration and buildup

  • Clean shower walls, glass doors, or curtains from top to bottom

  • Descale and scrub the showerhead to remove limescale

  • Clean and disinfect the bathtub, paying attention to edges and corners

  • Apply cleaner to the sink basin, countertop, and plughole

  • Wipe down sink surfaces carefully to protect porcelain, ceramic, stone, or metal finishes

  • Disinfect faucets, handles, and all high-touch areas

  • Clean cabinet doors and drawer fronts

  • Empty and wipe the inside of bathroom cabinets and drawers

  • Scrub the toilet bowl thoroughly, including under the rim

  • Disinfect the toilet seat, lid, handle, tank, and base

  • Clean the area behind and around the toilet

  • Polish mirrors using a streak-free glass cleaner and microfiber cloth

  • Sweep or vacuum the floor to remove hair, dust, and debris

  • Mop the entire floor with a disinfectant solution, reaching corners and edges

  • Clean baseboards and door frames

  • Sanitize trash bins inside and out

  • Wash shower curtains and bath mats

  • Ensure proper ventilation by using the exhaust fan or opening a window

This single, structured bathroom cleaning checklist ensures your cleaning session covers every visible and hidden surface.
